quiz.why: 影片說泡菜最好在地板上做，用亞洲式蹲姿處理高麗菜。

quiz.q: How long should the scallions be cut?
quiz.why: 蔥要切成 4 公分的火柴棒。

quiz.q: Why do they drain the cabbage?
options: So the kimchi is not too wet and salty
So the cabbage is easier to carry
quiz.why: 瀝掉多餘的鹽水，泡菜才不會太濕、太鹹。

quiz.q: What is the family's secret ingredient in their kimchi?
quiz.why: 他們家的泡菜秘方是新鮮蝦子。

quiz.q: Why do they use the outer cabbage leaves on top?
options: To protect the kimchi from too much oxygen
quiz.why: 外層菜葉可以保護泡菜不要接觸太多氧氣。

words.ex1: …if you're going to ferment it right
words.ex2: The sauce must ferment for two weeks before we test it.
words.ex2zh: 這個醬料必須先發酵兩週，我們才能檢測。
words.hook: 諧音「粉門特」：粉粉的麵團在門口自己膨起來＝發酵
words.pic: a baker looking happily at a bowl of dough that has puffed up with bubbles

words.ex2: What is the defect ratio for this batch?
words.ex2zh: 這一批的不良率是多少？
words.hook: 諧音「瑞休」：瑞士人休息時用杯子量比例＝比例
words.pic: a cook pouring two scoops of flour and one scoop of sugar into a bowl, measuring carefully

words.ex1: …this is the consistency you're looking for
words.ex2: We need more consistency in our product quality.
words.ex2zh: 我們的產品品質需要更一致。
words.hook: con 一起＋sist 站立＝東西站在一起不變＝一致、稠度穩定
words.pic: a cook lifting a spoon of thick sauce and letting it slowly drip back into the pot

words.ex2: Moisture can damage the circuit boards during storage.
words.ex2zh: 濕氣可能在倉儲時損壞電路板。
words.hook: 諧音「莫斯球」：莫斯科的球被水弄濕＝水分
words.pic: a person wiping water drops off a window on a rainy day with a towel

words.ex2: We want to reduce waste in the production line.
words.ex2zh: 我們想減少生產線上的浪費。
words.hook: 諧音「為斯特」：為了省錢，什麼都不要丟＝不要浪費
words.pic: a person throwing a full bag of food into a trash can while another person watches sadly

according: According to the manager, we ship on Friday.
根據經理說，我們週五出貨。
apple: I eat an apple every day.
boards: We check all the boards before shipping.
出貨前我們檢查所有的板子。
butter: Please put butter on the bread.
cabbage: The soup has cabbage in it.
carry: Can you carry this box for me?
你可以幫我搬這個箱子嗎？
circuit: The circuit has a small defect.
consistency: Consistency is key in quality control.
品管最重要的是一致性。
counter: Put the plates on the counter.
cut: Please cut the paper in half.
defect: We found a defect in the product.
我們在產品上發現一個瑕疵。
drain: Drain the water before you cook.
draw: The heat will draw out the water.
easier: 比較容易（easy 的比較級）
This tool makes the job easier.
這個工具讓工作更輕鬆。
family's: My family's house is near the station.
我家的房子在車站附近。
fancy: We had dinner at a fancy restaurant.
我們在一家高級餐廳吃晚餐。
fresh: I want fresh fruit for breakfast.
garden: They eat lunch in the garden.
goes: （nothing goes to waste）被…（go 的第三人稱）
The train goes to the airport.
honey: I put honey in my tea.
ingredient: 新鮮的食材讓料理更好吃。
island: The island in the kitchen is very big.
juice: I'd like a glass of orange juice.
kitchen: She is cooking in the kitchen.
leaves: The leaves turn red in autumn.
line: The production line stopped for an hour.
make: This sauce will make the dish spicy.
making: She is making dinner for us.
marble: The floor is made of marble.
這個地板是大理石做的。
moisture: Keep the boxes away from moisture.
mom: My mom calls me every Sunday.
我媽媽每個星期天都打給我。
nothing: There is nothing in the box.
outside: 我們在辦公室外面等吧。
prepared: The food was prepared by the chef.
product: 我們的新產品賣得很好。
ratio: The mixing ratio is two to one.
sauce: I like the sauce on this pasta.
我喜歡這份義大利麵的醬汁。
save: We can save time with this method.
這個方法可以節省時間。
shrimp: We had fried shrimp for lunch.
so: Check the label so we avoid mistakes.
檢查標籤，這樣才不會出錯。
sweeter: This cake is sweeter than that one.
tastes: 嚐起來（taste 的第三人稱）
test: We test every unit before shipping.
我們出貨前會測試每一台。
use: We use gloves in the lab.
我們在實驗室使用手套。
video: I watched a video about cooking.
我看了一支煮菜的影片。
wet: The floor is wet, be careful.
without: Don't go out without your phone.
